head: 3c65da1e

findings.summary: Top-level CLI catch discards the specific error id and prints a generic ACCEPTANCE_FULL_RUN_FAILED.
findings.failure_scenario: NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN unset → operator sees only the generic id.

findings.summary: invokedDirectly() swallows realpathSync errors → the CLI body never runs and the script exits 0.
findings.failure_scenario: A broken symlink makes the acceptance gate 'pass' without running.

findings.summary: readHostedBuildReceipt() collapses missing, corrupt and unreadable receipts into null.
findings.failure_scenario: A half-written receipt reads as 'build never run'.

findings.summary: Self-check ledger is fed by its own stubs, not by the production countedNetlifyApi wrapper.
findings.failure_scenario: A dropped method name stops counting in real runs while self-check stays green.

findings.summary: Pre-flight rehearsal receipt (browserRemainder 0) is echoed into the final run receipt as if post-run.
findings.failure_scenario: A leaked journey browser shows remainder 0 in the published receipt.

findings.summary: A secret-classified run id (written to Netlify as is_secret) is interpolated into a /tmp directory name, visible to any local user via ls /tmp.
findings.failure_scenario: Co-resident user on a shared runner reads the run id; not the auth secret, but a designed-secret value disclosed.

findings.summary: Bootstrap deadline (10 min) is stamped at create() before the deploy, but the deploy may take up to 20 min; a deploy over ~10 min guarantees BOOTSTRAP_CREATE_WINDOW_EXPIRED and a failed one-shot run.
findings.failure_scenario: DEV-37's single permitted deploy finishes at minute 12 and the run fails safely but permanently.

findings.summary: deployAttempted latched before deployOnce()'s pre-flight source check; a pre-flight throw reports deploys 1 and a phantom candidate identity lost.
findings.failure_scenario: Operator hunts a Netlify candidate that never existed.

test_command: no credentials: pnpm test:unit, test:netlify-package, acceptance:hosted:full-run:self-check; display: test:headed-browser; hosted + mutating (authorized only): acceptance:hosted:full-run
